text:
alex-r: heads-up: PR #4128 CI is red but only one matrix shard failed (linux-integration axis=2). failing test: TestStreamParser::test_large_input. got OOM during flush, exit 137.
ci-bot: Build 34892 failed on ubuntu-22.04 — matrix shard linux-integration (axis=2). exit_code=137. logs: https://ci.redwood/example/34892/shard2/logs.tar.gz
mike: @alex-r can we rerun just that shard and skip the image rebuild? want to avoid the ~12m image step.
tara: quick options: you can `gh workflow run ci-matrix.yml -f pr=4128 -f axis=linux-integration/2 --ref HEAD` but that triggers whole workflow.
jen-k: alternatively, target the job rerun endpoint: `gh api repos/redwood-inference/cicd/actions/runs/34892/jobs/23456/rerun` — but that sometimes re-triggers build steps.
mike: ops-bot supports a shorthand on PR comments to resubmit a single matrix job while preserving image cache. use: `@ci-bot retry job=linux-integration:2 no-image preserve-artifacts`
alex-r: doing that now (commenting on the PR).
ci-bot: Received command from alex-r: `retry job=linux-integration:2 no-image preserve-artifacts`. Scheduling rerun for job id 23456, preserving build cache and artifacts. Est. queue ~30s.
sre-oncall: FYI if it still OOMs: 1) try `TEST_CONCURRENCY=1` env on that job, 2) set `CI_RETRY_KEEP_ARTIFACTS=true` to keep previous logs for postmortem.
alex-r: rerun kicked off. I'll watch and post results.
ci-bot: Rerun started: job 23456 -> run 34893. logs: https://ci.redwood/example/34893/shard2/logs
mike: for CLI folks: you can trigger same via `gh pr comment 4128 --body "@ci-bot retry job=linux-integration:2 no-image preserve-artifacts"` from your machine/CI.
tara: small note — if you need to bisect the flaky test, run unit-level repeats with `pytest tests/test_stream.py::TestStreamParser::test_large_input -k large_input -n 1 --maxfail=1 --count=50` to collect failure patterns.
alex-r: good call. rerun finished — PASSED :tada: no rebuild needed. Thanks everyone.
mike: nice! :thumbsup:
jen-k: logging this pattern in our ops playbook (short targeted retry, no-image) so others use it.
alex-r: added a comment on the PR explaining root cause suspicion (memory spike). will follow up with a small test change to reduce buffer size.
